title: ChapterRevision
description: A chapter's text as it stood at one moment, kept whole rather than as a difference, so an old version reads without replaying the ones after it.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

chapter.description: The id of the chapter this is a revision of, in the system that holds the chapter.

version.description: Which revision of that chapter this is, counting up. Ordering comes from this and not from the clock, because two writes can land in the same second.

content.description: The whole text as it stood, not a difference against the one before.

changedBy.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of whoever made the change. Absent when it was made by software rather than a person.

changeType.description: What kind of change it was. Free text: the vocabulary belongs to the system that writes the revision.

changeSummary.description: One line on what changed, so a list of revisions can be read without opening each.

createdAt.description: When the revision was written down.
